_doc: Story 9.2 ANONYMIZED LOVABLE FIXTURE — quote (quote-version-visible) business shape. Preserves the customer-visible quote lines the version snapshot freezes + totals shape (base/option/VAT/deduction öre) that 9.3 compares. ZERO PII (synthetic labels, öre only). Every öre integer < 10 digits (orgnr-scan safe). Exercises the three-way origin machinery: a new-expected case, a SYNTHETIC documented-delta (numeric divergence, clearly marked synthetic), and a SYNTHETIC old-lovable PLACEHOLDER whose note states it carries NO real captured Lovable number (the real-example SELECTION is owner-gated, Sign-Off 8.2) — the origin LABEL is exercised so the machinery is genuinely used; NO real Lovable number is fabricated (AGENTS.md behavioral-oracle policy). The money-golden fixtures remain the single numeric authority for the pure engine; these totals are a representative quote SHAPE.

cases.note: A quote version with a base section + a selected tillval line; totals carry base/option/VAT öre. Preserves the quote-version-visible line + totals shape 9.3 compares. Representative öre, not a re-pin of a money-golden value.

SYNTHETIC documented-delta (NOT a real captured Lovable value): a numeric divergence. Two lines each sellOre 33333 @ 25%. Phase A per-line sum-of-rounded: round(33333*0.25)=round(8333.25)=8333 per line, summed = 16666 (the pinned vatOre). The plausible Lovable behavior rounded the VAT at the DOCUMENT level (round-of-sum): round(66666*0.25)=round(16666.5)=16667 (oldLovableWouldGive) — a 1-öre divergence from the per-line sum. The divergent old value is a NUMBER (oldLovableWouldGive), exercising the numeric arm of the documented-delta guard alongside the classification-code arm the crm/calc fixtures exercise.

SYNTHETIC old-lovable PLACEHOLDER — this case EXERCISES the old-lovable origin label so the three-way machinery is genuinely used, but it carries NO real captured Lovable number: the real-example SELECTION (which real Lovable quote becomes the oracle) is OWNER-GATED (Sign-Off 8.1/8.2, öppen (möte)). When the owner selects a real example, a real old-lovable case backfills here with NO fixture-schema change (this three-way origin already accommodates it).
